claims.text: The RAS events for compute node R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01 and R37-M1-NC-C:J02-U11 exhibit distinct error patterns.

The events for R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01 occur sporadically over a period of approximately 27 days, from June 3 to June 30, with varying error messages, including CE sym 2 and CE sym 0, and different masks.

In contrast, the events for R37-M1-NC-C:J02-U11 occur in a burst over a short period of approximately 9 hours on December 26, with a consistent error message indicating an instruction cache parity error corrected.
This burst of activity on R37-M1-NC-C:J02-U11, with 7 events occurring within a 7-hour window, appears more anomalous than the sporadic events on R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01.
The repetition of the same error message on R37-M1-NC-C:J02-U11 without any corrective action in between suggests a persistent issue.
The root cause of the anomaly is that these instruction cache parity errors on R37-M1-NC-C:J02-U11 recur repeatedly over a short period without any intervening corrective action.
